title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning
authors: Z. Shao, P. Wang, Q. Zhu, et al. (11 authors)
before: RL fine-tuning used PPO, which needs a separate value network alongside the policy.
problem: The value model doubles memory and is the fiddliest part of the pipeline to stabilise.
breakthrough: Group Relative Policy Optimization: sample a group of answers and use their relative scores as the baseline, dropping the critic entirely.
why: GRPO is what made large-scale RL for reasoning affordable, and it is the algorithm behind DeepSeek-R1.
next: DeepSeek-V3's post-training, then R1, then wide adoption across open reasoning models.
inherits: The RL algorithm most open reasoning training now uses.
